summary: Primary-only schedules with stable placement no longer wait indefinitely for a stale positive replication comparison.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill; existing catch-up and occurrence deduplication apply.

rules.detail: No replication or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Fresh missing-history comparisons and startup barriers still block. Standby schedules and any retained placement/owner change retain strict missing-history admission, including stale counts.

downtime.detail: No live-state changes or activation included.

recovery.detail: Stable primary-only schedules resume once a positive comparison is stale and at least one complete exchange has occurred since startup. Previously moved schedules conservatively require missing history to clear.
